title: Volcom Men's Wowzer Polo, Black, Size L

comparisons.notes: Men's Volcom Wowzer Polo, Black, Zappos SKU 8485449, size LG selectable, 60% cotton / 40% polyester with Stone embroidery matching the Woot photo.
Official Volcom store, Wowzer Polo in Black size L, SKU A0112303-BLK-L, UPC 196134366416, available at $48; photo matches Woot image.

writeup: Woot has the Volcom Wowzer Polo in black, men's size L, brand new for $4.99. Zappos sells the same polo for $36 and Volcom's own store charges $48, so this is about 86% below the cheapest store we found. It's a 60/40 cotton-poly blend with Volcom's embroidered Stone logo, limited to 10 per customer.
